name: Kakasd (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a blue lower part cut diagonally by a white wedge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kakasd (a blue shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above a scroll inscribed KAKASD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
